articles.title: Arizona confirms fifth screwworm case, expands quarantine
articles.description: Arizona confirmed its fifth New World screwworm case in a dog near Thatcher, expanding the quarantine into Graham County and restricting animal movement.

articles.title: Hundreds of cow carcasses reportedly burned near village outside Moscow following disease outbreak
articles.description: About 800 cow carcasses from the Rusmilk farm — the site of an outbreak of lumpy skin disease — were burned in the Moscow region, Telegram channels claimed.
